purpose: Bounds: 18 series per graph, 900 samples per series at every operation boundary, exact age retention against window_ms, append-only / front-evict-only / full-reset replace, offsets below 2^40, immutable graph identity, 16 graphs per session.

setup.note: 900 samples (the cap) and a 61-sample series in a 60 s window.

cases.name: partial-reset
cases.note: A RESET_RANGE onto a cached position rewrites a published sample. A base client applies it generically (Model::reset_range): the item at index 0 is replaced in place and the count stays 900.

cases.name: reset-range-cannot-shrink-a-series
cases.note: Why replace is not a reset: generically (Rust Model::reset_range, Swift Model.resetRange) total_count 2 sets the count to 2 and only [0, 2) is rewritten, so the 898 old samples at indices 2..899 stay cached beyond the count on every base client. It also necessarily breaks T7 (density); section 10.3 reports T5, the per-operation rule.

cases.name: reset-range-cannot-empty-a-series
cases.note: Generically total_count 0 is ignored and an empty range writes nothing: a no-op.
